# Process control

Starting processes with [`CreateProcessW`](/docs/api/windows/process-control#create-process-w), their startup information, inherited handles and waits.

<h2 id="security-attributes"><code>SecurityAttributes</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct SecurityAttributes {
    pub length: uint32;
    pub securityDescriptor: *opaque;
    pub inheritHandle: bool32;
}
```

The `SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES` a pipe or file is created with: here only whether its handle is inheritable.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/ProcessControl.rux#L7)

**Fields**

| Name                 | Type      | Description                                           |
| -------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `length`             | `uint32`  | The structure's size in bytes.                        |
| `securityDescriptor` | `*opaque` | A security descriptor, or null for the default.       |
| `inheritHandle`      | `bool32`  | Non-zero when a child process may inherit the handle. |

<h2 id="startup-info"><code>StartupInfo</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct StartupInfo {
    pub size: uint32;
    pub reserved: *opaque;
    pub desktop: *uint16;
    pub title: *uint16;
    pub x: uint32;
    pub y: uint32;
    pub xSize: uint32;
    pub ySize: uint32;
    pub xCountChars: uint32;
    pub yCountChars: uint32;
    pub fillAttribute: uint32;
    pub flags: uint32;
    pub showWindow: uint16;
    pub reserved2Size: uint16;
    pub reserved2: *opaque;
    pub standardInput: *opaque;
    pub standardOutput: *opaque;
    pub standardError: *opaque;
}
```

The `STARTUPINFOW` a new process is started with; this package fills in its standard handles.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/ProcessControl.rux#L18)

**Fields**

| Name             | Type      | Description                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `size`           | `uint32`  | The structure's size in bytes.                                                                                           |
| `reserved`       | `*opaque` | Reserved; null.                                                                                                          |
| `desktop`        | `*uint16` | The desktop, or null.                                                                                                    |
| `title`          | `*uint16` | The console title, or null.                                                                                              |
| `x`              | `uint32`  | The window's left edge, when `flags` says so.                                                                            |
| `y`              | `uint32`  | The window's top edge, when `flags` says so.                                                                             |
| `xSize`          | `uint32`  | The window's width, when `flags` says so.                                                                                |
| `ySize`          | `uint32`  | The window's height, when `flags` says so.                                                                               |
| `xCountChars`    | `uint32`  | The console buffer's width in characters, when `flags` says so.                                                          |
| `yCountChars`    | `uint32`  | The console buffer's height in characters, when `flags` says so.                                                         |
| `fillAttribute`  | `uint32`  | The console's text and background colors, when `flags` says so.                                                          |
| `flags`          | `uint32`  | Which fields the system reads, such as [`STARTF_USESTDHANDLES`](/docs/api/windows/process-control#startf-usestdhandles). |
| `showWindow`     | `uint16`  | How the window is shown, when `flags` says so.                                                                           |
| `reserved2Size`  | `uint16`  | Reserved; zero.                                                                                                          |
| `reserved2`      | `*opaque` | Reserved; null.                                                                                                          |
| `standardInput`  | `*opaque` | The child's standard input.                                                                                              |
| `standardOutput` | `*opaque` | The child's standard output.                                                                                             |
| `standardError`  | `*opaque` | The child's standard error.                                                                                              |

<h2 id="process-information"><code>ProcessInformation</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct ProcessInformation {
    pub process: *opaque;
    pub thread: *opaque;
    pub processId: uint32;
    pub threadId: uint32;
}
```

The `PROCESS_INFORMATION` [`CreateProcessW`](/docs/api/windows/process-control#create-process-w) fills in: the new process and its first thread.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/ProcessControl.rux#L59)

**Fields**

| Name        | Type      | Description                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `process`   | `*opaque` | The new process's handle, to wait on and close. |
| `thread`    | `*opaque` | Its first thread's handle, to close.            |
| `processId` | `uint32`  | The process identifier.                         |
| `threadId`  | `uint32`  | The first thread's identifier.                  |

```rux
pub const STARTF_USESTDHANDLES: uint32 = 0x00000100;
```

<h2 id="create-process-w"><code>CreateProcessW</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func CreateProcessW(
    applicationName: *uint16,
    commandLine: *var uint16,
    processAttributes: *SecurityAttributes,
    threadAttributes: *SecurityAttributes,
    inheritHandles: bool32,
    creationFlags: uint32,
    environment: *opaque,
    currentDirectory: *uint16,
    startupInfo: *StartupInfo,
    processInformation: *var ProcessInformation
) -> bool32
```

Starts a program as a new process.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createprocessw](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createprocessw)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/ProcessControl.rux#L116)

**Parameters**

| Name                 | Type                      | Description                                                                                                |
| -------------------- | ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `applicationName`    | `*uint16`                 | the program's path, or null to take it from the command line                                               |
| `commandLine`        | `*var uint16`             | the command line, which the call may modify                                                                |
| `processAttributes`  | `*SecurityAttributes`     | the process handle's security, or null                                                                     |
| `threadAttributes`   | `*SecurityAttributes`     | the thread handle's security, or null                                                                      |
| `inheritHandles`     | `bool32`                  | non-zero to let the child inherit the parent's inheritable handles                                         |
| `creationFlags`      | `uint32`                  | flags such as [`CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT`](/docs/api/windows/process-control#create-unicode-environment) |
| `environment`        | `*opaque`                 | the environment block, or null to inherit the parent's                                                     |
| `currentDirectory`   | `*uint16`                 | the child's working directory, or null for the parent's                                                    |
| `startupInfo`        | `*StartupInfo`            | how the child starts, including its standard handles                                                       |
| `processInformation` | `*var ProcessInformation` | receives the new process and thread                                                                        |

**Returns**: non-zero on success, and zero on failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)

<h2 id="duplicate-handle"><code>DuplicateHandle</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func DuplicateHandle(
    sourceProcess: *opaque,
    sourceHandle: *opaque,
    targetProcess: *opaque,
    targetHandle: *var *opaque,
    desiredAccess: uint32,
    inheritHandle: bool32,
    options: uint32
) -> bool32
```

Duplicates a handle, here into the same process with different inheritance.

**See also**: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/handleapi/nf-handleapi-duplicatehandle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/handleapi/nf-handleapi-duplicatehandle)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Windows/Src/ProcessControl.rux#L168)

**Parameters**

| Name            | Type           | Description                                                                                                          |
| --------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sourceProcess` | `*opaque`      | the process that owns the handle                                                                                     |
| `sourceHandle`  | `*opaque`      | the handle                                                                                                           |
| `targetProcess` | `*opaque`      | the process to duplicate it into                                                                                     |
| `targetHandle`  | `*var *opaque` | receives the duplicate                                                                                               |
| `desiredAccess` | `uint32`       | the access to grant, ignored with [`DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS`](/docs/api/windows/process-control#duplicate-same-access) |
| `inheritHandle` | `bool32`       | non-zero to make the duplicate inheritable                                                                           |
| `options`       | `uint32`       | flags such as [`DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS`](/docs/api/windows/process-control#duplicate-same-access)                     |

**Returns**: non-zero on success, and zero on failure with the reason in [`GetLastError`](/docs/api/windows/errors#get-last-error)
